REQUEST FOR EXPRESSIONS OF INTEREST

(CONSULTING SERVICES – INDIVIDUAL SELECTION)

COUNTRY: UGANDA

Project Name: Horn of Africa Coordination Support Team Fiduciary Institution Project

Loan No./Credit No./ Grant No.: TF0B7882

Project ID No.: P178159

 

 

Assignment Name

Proc Ref No as per Procurement Plan

1

Senior Operations Officer (Results & Communication)

 UG-IUCEA-577537-CS-INDV

The Inter University Council for East Africa (IUCEA) has received financing from the World Bank toward the cost of the Horn of Africa Coordination Support Team Fiduciary Institution Project, and intends to apply part of the proceeds for consulting services.

The consulting services (“the Services”) ie Senior Operations Officer (Results and Communication). To monitor and track key result areas and professionally manage communication channels and information for the Initiative.

The detailed Terms of Reference (TOR) for the assignments can be found at the following website: www.iucea.org and www.hoainitiative.org.

IUCEA now invites eligible individuals (“Consultants”) to indicate their interest in providing the Services. Interested Consultants should provide information demonstrating that they have the required qualifications and relevant experience to perform the Services in their updated Curriculum Vitae.

The attention of interested Consultants is drawn to Section III, paragraphs, 3.14, 3.16, and 3.17 of the World Bank’s “Procurement Regulations for IPF Borrowers” November 2020 (“Procurement Regulations”), setting forth the World Bank’s policy on conflict of interest.

The individuals will be selected in accordance with the Individual Consultant Selection (ICS) method set out in the Procurement Regulations as Revised November 2020.

Further information can be obtained at the address below during office hours 0800 to 1700 hours.

Applications for expressions of interest with respective updated and signed curriculum vitae and any supporting documents must be delivered in a written form to the address below by e-mail only not later than 1700hrs East African Time (EAT) of 06th November, 2026.

Attn:

Prof Idris Rai Ahmed

Ag. Executive Secretary

Inter University Council for East Africa

P.O Box 7110 Kampala, Uganda

Emails: recruit@iucea.org, copied to ckakooza@iucea.org and nkaminyoge@iucea.org
